data.narrative:
TrustPoint is a Seed-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Patrick Shannon and Chris DeMay that has raised $6.5M to date. The valuation universe for Space & Aerospace comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including Starcloud, SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, and Sierra Space.

Stage-progression analysis is the only applicable triangulation method given data constraints. Using total capital raised ($6.5M) as a baseline proxy and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $16M. Peer-median analysis cannot support conclusions; while 14 same-sector private companies exist, only 1 occupies TrustPoint's stage and valuation tier, falling short of the 3-datapoint minimum for statistical reliability. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (6 tickers, 24.4x sector median) cannot be applied without target revenue disclosure, which remains unavailable.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $14M–$19M (centered at $16M), anchored primarily to stage-progression mechanics. Key uncertainties include the company's revenue trajectory, capital efficiency relative to peer cohorts, and the materiality of any interim funding rounds or operational milestones. A more granular valuation would benefit from disclosed or modeled revenue and confirmed comparable funding multiples within the narrow Seed-stage Space & Aerospace subset.
